name: Testing Quality
purpose: Design and execute deterministic, isolated, and behavior-oriented test suites across the testing pyramid.
inputs: Feature acceptance criteria and observable behavior
Target module, public API, and regression baseline
Test framework, fixtures, and CI execution constraints
outputs: Deterministic unit, integration, and critical E2E tests
Coverage, mutation, flake, and performance evidence
Quality assessment with residual test gaps
stop_conditions: The suite is deterministic, isolated, behavior-oriented, and regression evidence is recorded
